# Jonas Ekström-Bell

Backend Engineer
Gothenburg, Sweden · jonas.ekstrom@example.test · github.com/jekstrom-dev

---

## About

I build payment and messaging back-ends on the JVM. I like small services, boring technology and
well-written post-mortems. Interested in distributed systems problems where correctness matters.

## Experience

### Skerry Payments

**Senior Developer** | Skerry Payments | 2020 - present

- Own the card-authorisation service (Kotlin, Spring Boot, PostgreSQL) handling ~900 requests per second
- Replaced a polling integration with Kafka events, cutting settlement delay from 15 minutes to under 10 seconds
- Introduced contract tests between 11 services and a canary release process on AWS
- Interview and onboard new engineers; wrote the team's incident-review template

### Nordic Mapworks

**Developer** | Nordic Mapworks | 2016 - 2020

- Developed Java back-ends for a fleet-routing product serving 40 municipalities
- Migrated the database from MySQL to PostgreSQL with zero downtime using logical replication
- Wrote the Docker-based local environment that cut new-joiner setup time from 2 days to 2 hours

### Hexa Telecom

**Support Engineer** | Hexa Telecom | 2014 - 2016

- Second-line support for a billing platform; wrote SQL reports and fixed defects in the Java code base
